text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the VR world, I spotted Darley Arabian 
counseling a horse girl.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
My instructor told me I'm better suited 
for dirt than turf...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
...But I don't want to give up on turf. 
What should I do?

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text: I see, I see. Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text: —Alright, how about a game of tag!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text: Ready, set, go!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Huh, tag...?! W-Wait up~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Come now, turf is your passion, right? 
Chase after me with all you've got!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
She's already all the way over there?! 
S-So fast...!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Haha, feels great, doesn't it? Sand isn't 
half bad either, right?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Uwoooohhhh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two returned from their game of tag. 
...It seems she couldn't catch Darley 
Arabian in the end.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... Ugh. I couldn't... catch 
up at all...

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Still, you can see it now, can't you? 
...Where you currently stand.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
You're still developing. True, your 
running fits dirt better, but during our 
chase, surface made no difference to you!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Meaning right now, you have equal 
potential on both!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Taking on both turf and dirt sounds 
exciting. Who knows, you might even 
possess the unique talent to dominate 
both!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Then what should I do to run 
both?

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Listen to various perspectives. For 
instance... little lamb over there. What 
would you do?

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! If you're challenging both turf 
and dirt, raising all basic capabilities 
across the board is wise.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
I shall bestow upon you ancient and modern 
wisdom. Devote yourself to training with 
all your heart!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Cultivating distinct strengths 
broadens future horizons even further!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Your cadence frequency was truly 
remarkable! Let's polish that unique trait 
of yours!
